entries.zh: 識破；预知、看破先机（谓预先识破未显之事，与「说预言」义相涉）
entries.en: to see through beforehand, to foreknow; to prophesy
entries.notes: 汉字「識破」与音写 cham-pua 的对应存疑，据西语 profetizar（说预言）定「预知、看破」义

entries.zh: 生知人；先知（谓生而知之、不学而知的人）
entries.en: prophet; one who knows by nature (things not learned)

entries.zh: 先人；先知先觉之人（承先知词族）；亦泛指祖先、先辈
entries.en: men who know or are enlightened before others (within this prophet cluster); also ancestors, forebears
entries.notes: 西语词头栏空；「先人」兼「先觉者」与「祖先」两义，据前后两条 profeta 词族取「先知先觉之人」为主，兼收祖先义

entries.zh: 先知人；先知（能先知先觉、预知未然者）
entries.en: prophet; one who foreknows

entries.zh: 聖跡；圣迹（圣人的灵迹神迹，或指圣人事迹遗迹）
entries.en: miracles (of saints); sacred traces or relics
entries.notes: 西语词头栏空，据汉字「圣迹」与音写 sèng-tsè 释义，灵迹/圣物两解并存

entries.zh: 預先知；预知（预先知晓未然之事）；兼指预言
entries.en: to know beforehand; foreknowledge; prophecy

entries.zh: 鑑冊；预言册书、谶书（载预言占验之册）
entries.en: a book of prophecies; book of divination oracles
entries.notes: 音写 sing-cam-che 三音节与汉字两字不合（首音节疑衍「聖」），据西语 libro de profecías 释义

entries.zh: 淵；深渊（如海之极深处）
entries.en: abyss; depth as of the sea, deep pool

entries.zh: 深奥难解之物（据西语残文 profunda cosa 姑定）
entries.en: a profound, abstruse thing (tentative gloss)
entries.notes: 西语词头残乱（vra 之展开与句尾脱字依赖推断），汉字「徵」与音写 uy-bian 难以对应互证，释义存疑

entries.zh: 深；深奥、精深（如教义之深奥难测）
entries.en: deep, profound (as of mysteries or doctrine); abstruse

entries.zh: 澳；深、深奥（谓水深澳深，亦喻义理深奥）
entries.en: deep; profound (said of waters or doctrine); deep bay

entries.zh: 深处；澳深之水（海的深处）
entries.en: depth, deep place (as of the sea)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字「安」与音写 va 及西语注不合（疑「窪/灣」之讹），据西语 profundo…del mar 定「深处」义

entries.zh: 秘；秘密、隐秘（深藏于心不可测者）
entries.en: secret, hidden, occult (as in the mind); profound

entries.zh: 祖先、祖辈；亦涉先人名讳之避称（諱）
entries.en: progenitors, ancestors, grandparents; tabooed names of deceased forebears
entries.notes: 汉字「祀諱」与音写 huan-huy 对应存疑，音写栏另含西语批注（examinale, nota que es）；据西语 Progenitores/abuelos 定「祖先」义

entries.zh: 戒；禁止、戒绝，兼指告戒、阻拦
entries.en: to prohibit, to forbid; to admonish; to hinder

entries.zh: 禁；禁止、禁绝
entries.en: to prohibit, to ban; prohibition
entries.notes: 汉字单字「禁」而音写两音节 guim-yo，与第 18 条「禁約」同音，疑即「禁约」，据西语 prohibir 释义

entries.zh: 勿；勿、不要（客气的禁阻之辞，谓勿使行之）
entries.en: do not (negative imperative); to prohibit politely, "let it not be done"
entries.notes: 西语词头中段残乱（con sin y baldra 难确读），据汉字「勿」与 no se haga（勿使行）释义

entries.zh: 禁約；禁约（禁止、约束，亦指禁约条文）
entries.en: to prohibit and restrain; prohibition, restrictive compact

entries.zh: 阻當（阻挡）；阻拦、阻挡、拦阻
entries.en: to block, to obstruct, to bar

entries.zh: 不准；不准许、不许可
entries.en: to not permit, to disallow
